In today’s GRWM, I’m talking about the rise of C-Beauty, how Chinese beauty brands have evolved over the past few years, and why consumer perception is shifting globally. From packaging and formulation to branding and innovation, C-Beauty is no longer what it used to be — and it’s becoming a serious player alongside K-Beauty.

As someone working in the K-beauty industry, I’ve been watching this shift closely. More people are discovering C-Beauty internationally, and the growth is happening faster than most people expected.

In this video, we’ll get into:

Why C-Beauty is gaining global attention

snippet.title: This Is Why These Are the New Viral K-Beauty Sunscreens 😳
snippet.description:
POV: not all sunscreens are the same… and that’s exactly why you need options 😳
Most people think SPF is just “SPF”… but the finish, texture, and skin benefits can completely change how your skin looks (and whether you’ll actually use it) 👀

Here’s how to choose your SPF from House of Hur 👇
☀️ House of Hur Weightless Sun Fluid
→ ultra-light, fast-absorbing, feels like skincare
→ perfect for oily/combo skin or reapplying over makeup without messing it up

🌴 House of Hur Tropical Dew Sun Cream
→ richer, hydrating texture
→ gives that dewy, glass skin glow ✨
→ best if your skin leans dry or you love a luminous finish

🍵 House of Hur Matcha Light Sun Cream
→ lightweight but calming
→ packed with antioxidants (like EGCG from matcha) to help soothe + balance skin 💧
→ great for stressed, sensitive, or acne-prone skin
